motion.name: reveal-standard
motion.purpose: Default FadeInItem and RevealItem entrance duration; reduced motion uses a 150ms fade without delay or translation. WelcomeSection overrides durations to 550–600ms with no entrance delays below 900px.

motion.name: interactive-dot-pulse
motion.purpose: InteractiveHoverButton resting dot pulse; disabled during interaction and for reduced motion.

motion.name: interactive-dot-fill
motion.purpose: InteractiveHoverButton expanding dot; disabled for reduced motion.

motion.name: project-scale-entrance
motion.purpose: WelcomeSection project previews scale from 0.96 to 1 after image load and viewport visibility. Reduced motion removes scale and uses a 150ms fade without delay.

motion.name: project-float
motion.purpose: Only Actio and Zeynep Dikdüş float on desktop. Pause offscreen and in hidden tabs; disable below 900px and for reduced motion.

motion.name: welcome-cta-entrance
motion.purpose: Both hero CTAs reveal together. Mobile entrance delay is zero; reduced motion removes translation and uses a 150ms fade without delay.

motion.name: footer-artwork-scroll
motion.purpose: Footer uses fixed 5% horizontal and 36px vertical padding. Only decorative artwork scales from full width to its inset frame; text and layout remain stable. Reduced motion fixes scaleX at 1. The heading reuses FadeInItem with a 500ms normal delay and a delay-free 150ms reduced-motion fade.

motion.name: global-reduced-motion
motion.purpose: src/app/global.css switches smooth scrolling to auto and disables .scale-on-hover transitions and enlargement. Navbar home navigation uses behavior: auto so global CSS controls scrolling.

motion.name: section-flow-pattern
motion.value: 10s linear infinite; paired beats 650ms apart, 4.8s forward travel followed by a pause; horizontal delays 0/4s, vertical 2/6s
motion.purpose: Faded reference-style square grid in WhoAmISection. Short gradient pulses travel left-to-right and top-to-bottom along aligned grid lines. Pauses offscreen/in hidden tabs; reduced motion retains only the static grid.

motion.name: work-card-entrance
motion.value: 700ms cubic-bezier(0.22,0.61,0.36,1); opacity 450ms; once when the stationary outer layout box enters the viewport by 48px
motion.purpose: MyWorkCard enters from below (40px desktop, 28px below 900px) with an 8px desktop lateral offset following animationDirection. useInView observes the untransformed outer box with once:true, amount:some and margin:0px 0px -48px 0px, triggering when the layout box extends 48px into the viewport. Opacity goes from 0 to 1 during entrance. Once started, the animation completes even if scrolling stops and never resets. No independent image-scale entrance remains. Reduced motion renders the final state immediately. Optional entranceDelay (default 0 seconds) delays both translation and opacity; the projects listing passes 0.32 seconds. Reduced motion ignores the delay.

motion.name: work-card-interaction
motion.purpose: Fine-pointer hover and keyboard focus scale contained imagery to 1.02 and translate the decorative arrow 3px. Reduced motion disables transforms and transitions. The external 3px green focus outline stays visible; no button shadows.

motion.name: projects-introduction-entrance
motion.value: 500ms ease-out; title delay 0ms, subtitle delay 160ms, card delay 320ms
motion.purpose: src/app/[locale]/projects/page.tsx reuses RevealItem for the title (20px rise) and subtitle (16px rise). Listing cards pass entranceDelay={0.32} after their viewport trigger. Reduced motion removes text translation and delays, uses a 150ms text fade, and shows cards immediately.

responsive.projectCard: MyWorkCard uses full width, wrapping text, a 7:5 contained-image media frame capped at 400px and 16px corners on surfaceSubtle (#F6F8FA). Text minimum height is 0 below 900px and 200px above. Props: title, description, images, href, animationDirection (left/right, default left), sizes (optional Next Image override), titleComponent (h2 or h5, default h5), entranceDelay (seconds, default 0; ignored for reduced motion). The listing passes titleComponent="h2" under its H1; visual h5 typography remains unchanged. Default sizes matches MyWorksSection: one column below 900px, two columns with a 64px gutter above; project listing overrides sizes for its 600px breakpoint and 32px gutter.
responsive.singleImageRow: **SingleImageRow** — `src/components/ProjectDetails/SingleImageRow/index.tsx`: contained gallery image on `semanticColors.surfaceSubtle` (`#F6F8FA`, matching MyWorkCard) opening the existing fullscreen modal. Props: `imageUrl`, `alt`, optional `containerStyle` (`sx` override), `onImageOpen(imageUrl, previewUrl?)` to delegate to a shared viewer. Usage: `<SingleImageRow imageUrl={url} alt={alt} />`. Media height is `clamp(220px, 56vw, 640px)`. Source aspect ratio limits responsive download width to the actual contained image width. Clicking captures the loaded thumbnail for the modal preview. With `onImageOpen`, the row delegates opening and does not render its local modal.
responsive.multipleImageRow: **MultipleImageRow** — `src/components/ProjectDetails/MultipleImageRow/index.tsx`: gallery images on `semanticColors.surfaceSubtle` (`#F6F8FA`, matching MyWorkCard) using the same fullscreen modal. Props: `images` (`url`, `alt`), optional `containerStyle` (`sx` override), `onImageOpen(imageUrl, previewUrl?)` to delegate to a shared viewer. Usage: `<MultipleImageRow images={images} />`. Below 600px images stack, each with height `clamp(220px, 75vw, 400px)`; above, they share a row with height `clamp(280px, 45vw, 640px)`. Each image’s responsive download width accounts for its source aspect ratio and frame height. Clicking captures the loaded thumbnail for the modal preview. With `onImageOpen`, the row delegates opening and does not render its local modal.
responsive.welcome: Hero CTAs span available width below 600px with a 16px gap; above they wrap with a 150px minimum and a 32px gap. They have a 40px minimum height with multiline labels. IhrHaus preview max-width: 100%. Below 900px, WelcomeSection adds 96px bottom padding to accommodate the collage's 100px bottom overflow and preserve separation from WhoAmISection; desktop bottom padding is zero.
responsive.contact: ContactHeader text uses width: 100%, min-width: 0 and overflow-wrap: anywhere. Path: src/components/ContactSection/ContactHeader/index.tsx. Prop: scrollYProgress (MotionValue<number>). Usage: <ContactHeader scrollYProgress={scrollYProgress} />. A module-level motion.create(Stack) wrapper accepts the opacity and vertical MotionValues directly, without type assertions. ContactForm email also uses overflow-wrap: anywhere.
responsive.process: ProcessSection has no fixed mobile height and a 750px desktop minimum. ProcessCard grows with text; padding is 16px below 600px and 32px above. Image minimum height: 220px at xs, 240px at sm, 180px at md. Optional ProcessCard imagePosition (center by default, or bottom) controls contained image alignment. Design and Development use bottom with zero bottom padding at every breakpoint; artwork clips to card corners. Improvement stays centered. Below 900px, optional mobileImageHeight overrides the image-area minimum height and mobileImageScale (default 1) scales artwork from the bottom. Design uses mobileImageHeight={360}; Development uses mobileImageScale={1.35}. At 900px and above original desktop sizing is retained; Improvement sizing remains unchanged. ProcessCard background uses semanticColors.surfaceSubtle (#F6F8FA).
responsive.biography: WhoAmISection uses a flexible text column and 320px square portrait at 900px and above. Below 900px, the portrait follows the introduction and sole project action and is capped at 360px; service columns stack. The project action reuses AnimatedTextLink to link to #works and uses intrinsic width, 16px semibold brick text via a section-specific semanticColors.actionSecondary override, a 20px right arrow and a 44px minimum height. Its 2px underline scales from left to right over 280ms on hover or keyboard focus, immediately for reduced motion. It retains a visible focus outline and an unfilled surface. The section omits its contact CTA and retains a 96px anchor offset. On hover or keyboard focus, its arrow moves 3px horizontally and back in a repeating 1600ms ease-in-out cycle; it stops on leaving the interaction and is disabled for reduced motion. FlowPattern spans the complete section at every breakpoint behind the content; its clipped layers cannot cause page overflow. The portrait-local DotPattern is removed.
responsive.worksSection: MyWorksSection uses a single column below 900px, a staggered two-column layout above, 32px/64px gaps below/above 900px, and top padding 64px below 600px, 96px at 600–899px, 192px above. Heading minimum height is 0 below 900px and 150px above.
responsive.navigation: Navbar mobile home control and menu trigger are at least 44px high; the menu trigger is at least 44px wide. Mobile logo artwork stays 75x25px. Navbar overrides InteractiveHoverButton minHeight to 44px below 900px and 36px above. LanguageSelector has a minimum 44x44px button surrounding the unchanged 30x30px flag.

imageLoading.sizes: Active portfolio `fill` images declare `sizes` matching their layout: process columns, a portrait at 320px on desktop and capped at 360px on mobile, project cards divided by image count, gallery rows divided by image count, and a modal capped at 900px. Footer artwork uses `100vw` to cover its full-width transformed state. `ProcessCard` accepts an optional `sizes` override; `ProcessSection` supplies the narrower design-column width. Existing gallery `containerStyle` overrides should keep the declared image width in mind.
imageLoading.quality: Next Image uses default quality 75 for process artwork, portrait, hero previews and cards. Modal images use quality 90. Gallery thumbnails retain quality 50, explicitly allowed alongside 75 and 90 in `next.config.mjs`. Source assets remain intact.
imageLoading.heroPreload: Only the main FitNLit hero preview has an image preload, restricted by `media="(min-width: 900px)"`. Its `srcset` and `sizes` are generated with `getImageProps` from the same props as the image. Below 900px the collage follows the text and uses lazy loading. Other portfolio imagery stays lazy loaded except the explicitly opened modal image.
imageLoading.modal: **FullScreenImageModal** — `src/components/FullScreenImageModal/index.tsx`: contained image viewer. Props: `isOpen`, `onClose`, optional `imageUrl`, `alt`, `previewUrl` (the loaded thumbnail’s exact `currentSrc`), `navigation` (`index`, `count`, `onPrevious`, `onNext`). Usage: `<FullScreenImageModal isOpen={open} onClose={close} imageUrl={url} previewUrl={previewUrl} alt={alt} />`. Reuses the loaded preview immediately until the quality-90 image finishes decoding; a failed full-size request leaves the preview visible. Only the opened modal loads its high-quality image, eagerly and with high fetch priority. Its positioned image frame is capped at 900px wide, `90vh` high and the viewport height minus 64px; `sizes` accounts for the source aspect ratio and both bounds while retaining browser DPR selection. When `navigation.count > 1`, a 56px footer outside the image holds 44×44px previous/next controls and a localized live position counter. Image height and responsive source sizing subtract the footer height. Left/right arrow keys navigate while open; modified shortcuts are ignored and Escape retains normal close behavior. Without navigation or with only one image, the footer is hidden. Navigation and loading/error messages use matching accessibility keys in both locales. If no loaded preview exists, a labeled progress indicator appears while loading; an error message replaces it if loading fails.
imageLoading.processProps: ProcessCard adds optional sizes; default matches the wider desktop column and ProcessSection overrides it for the narrower design column. Optional imagePosition: center | bottom (default center). Usage: <ProcessCard title={title} description={description} imageUrl="/services/design.webp" alt={alt} imagePosition="bottom" />. Development supplies mobile sizes matching its 1.35x image scale.
imageLoading.metadata: Gallery and modal aspect ratios come from `src/data/project-image-dimensions.json`, generated from the original assets by `scripts/generate-project-image-dimensions.mjs`. Refresh with `yarn images:metadata`; `predev` and `prebuild` also refresh it. Unknown sources fall back to width-only sizing. Custom gallery `containerStyle` changes to media dimensions need corresponding sizing updates.
imageLoading.gallery: **ImageGallery** — `src/components/ProjectDetails/ImageGallery.tsx`: client component composing the existing SingleImageRow and MultipleImageRow with one shared fullscreen viewer. Prop: `assetRows` (`AssetRow[]`). Usage: `<ImageGallery key={slug} assetRows={assetRows} />`. Retains the existing project assets Stack layout and page order, flattening all rows into one navigable sequence. Opens the clicked image, reuses loaded thumbnails on navigation, and wraps from the final image to the first and back. Only the selected full-quality image is mounted; no adjacent-image prefetch. The parent keys by project slug to reset selection between projects. Rows retain their local modal behavior when used without `onImageOpen`.

composition.biography: `src/components/WhoAmISection/index.tsx`: server-rendered, localized introduction for prospective clients. No props; usage: `<WhoAmISection />`. A two-part `h2`, short introduction, project anchor link, and portrait precede three open, divider-led service columns: end-to-end development, AI-powered products/automation, and agentic coding with human engineering oversight. No individual project examples or metrics appear here. Desktop uses a flexible text column and 320px square portrait; below 900px the portrait follows the introduction and project action, and service columns stack. The portrait caps at 360px on mobile. The sole action reuses `AnimatedTextLink` to link to `#works`, with a section-specific `semanticColors.actionSecondary` override for 16px semibold brick text, a 20px right arrow, and a 44px minimum height. A 2px underline scales from left to right over 280ms on hover or keyboard focus; the arrow moves 3px horizontally and back in a repeating 1600ms ease-in-out cycle during the same interaction. Leaving hover/focus returns it to rest. Reduced motion makes the underline immediate and disables arrow movement. The link retains a visible focus outline, intrinsic width and an unfilled surface. The contact CTA is omitted from this section. The section retains `id="about"`, adds a named section landmark and 96px anchor offset, and uses semantic color tokens. Entrance and portrait motion stay in the existing `FadeInItem` and `RevealItem` client components; `FlowPattern` supplies a full-section square grid fading toward all edges, with paired heartbeat pulses traveling left-to-right and top-to-bottom along grid lines, paused offscreen/in hidden tabs and static for reduced motion, replacing the portrait-local DotPattern; CTA interaction styles live in `AnimatedTextLink`; service copy is visible without entrance animation. Copy lives under matching `who_am_i_section` keys in both locale files.
composition.projects: `src/components/MyWorksSection/index.tsx`: server-rendered selected project layout and localized summaries. No props; usage: `<MyWorksSection />`. Full project data and locale selection stay on the server; cards receive serializable display props and `href`. Uses a single column below 900px, preserving the staggered two-column desktop layout above. Gaps are 32px below 900px and 64px above; top padding is 64px below 600px, 96px at 600–899px and 192px on desktop. The heading block has no minimum height on small screens. The project-list CTA reuses `AnimatedTextLink` with an explicitly locale-prefixed destination, giving one keyboard stop, visible focus and the shared underline/arrow treatment. The project listing at src/app/[locale]/projects/page.tsx retains two columns from 600px and supplies its own image sizes override.
composition.boundaries: MyWorkCard, FadeInItem and RevealItem explicitly declare use client. MyWorkCard requires href resolved by the locale-aware Link, with no nested interactive CTA or extra keyboard stop. Its 700ms entrance observes the stationary outer box and starts when the box extends 48px into the viewport, using a fixed bottom inset rather than a percentage threshold. Opacity reaches 1 in 450ms; the animation completes independently of scrolling and never resets. Images have no separate entrance-scale animation. Reduced motion shows the full card immediately. The focus outline is outside the unclipped link; clipping is inside visual content. FadeInItem and RevealItem retain their documented timings.
composition.process: src/components/ProcessSection/index.tsx and ProcessCard render on the server; ProcessSection has no props, usage <ProcessSection /> and getTranslations for localized copy.
composition.animatedTextLink: src/components/AnimatedTextLink/index.tsx is a client component rendering a native MUI link by default. Required props: children, href. Optional icon replaces the default right arrow; icon={null} hides it. Standard MUI Link props (excluding underline) plus sx style overrides are supported. Usage: <AnimatedTextLink href="#works">Explore my work</AnimatedTextLink>. WhoAmISection delegates all project CTA styles and interactions to this component. WhoAmISection overrides sx.color with semanticColors.actionSecondary (brick); icon and underline inherit it. The reusable default and focus ring remain green. MyWorksSection also reuses AnimatedTextLink for the project-list CTA with a server-resolved locale-prefixed href, retaining one keyboard stop and the shared underline/arrow/focus behavior.
composition.flowPattern: src/components/FlowPattern/index.tsx: decorative client component, no props; usage <FlowPattern /> in a positioned, isolated section with content at zIndex 1. Full-bounds aria-hidden, pointer-transparent clipped layer at zIndex 0. Stationary 1px square grid with 7.5% green alpha; cells 64px below 900px and 96px above. A radial ellipse at 50%/55% fades the grid toward all edges, following the supplied reference on white. Two horizontal tracks at rows 3 and 9/6 (mobile/desktop), and two vertical tracks at columns 2/4 and 5/10, carry paired 144px gradient segments with 28% peak green alpha and 650ms spacing. Each 10-second cycle travels forward for 4.8s then pauses. Track delays: horizontal 0/4s, vertical 2/6s. Only transforms and opacity animate. useInView and document visibility pause offscreen/hidden animation; reduced motion hides pulse tracks and retains the static grid. An intersected vertical mask fades the grid and pulses below 40% section height to 35% opacity at 60% and fully transparent at 76%, keeping capability divider lines distinct.
composition.projectsContactClosing: **Projects listing contact closing** — `src/app/[locale]/projects/page.tsx`: server-rendered section after the project grid; no new component or props. A named section landmark (`aria-labelledby="projects-contact-title"`) contains an Oswald H2, short localized paragraph and the existing AnimatedTextLink pointing to `/${locale}/#contact`. Usage is built into the Projects page. A quiet semantic border separates it from the list; content stacks below 900px and becomes a text/action row above. Heading sizes are 32px / 40px at xs / md; the link retains its 44px minimum height, shared focus and reduced-motion behavior. Copy lives under matching `projects.contact_title`, `contact_description` and `contact_cta` keys in both locales. The page container uses 32px bottom padding below 900px and 96px above; combined with the footer’s 36px top padding, the closing-to-artwork gap is 68px on mobile and 132px on desktop.
composition.projectsIntroduction: **Projects listing introduction** — `src/app/[locale]/projects/page.tsx`: server-rendered page header with a large Oswald H1 and introductory paragraph stacked at every viewport, separated by a 16px gap. Title sizes are 48px below 600px, 64px from 600px and 80px from 1200px, with weight 600, line-height 1.1 and -0.02em tracking; this is a page-specific heading treatment. Paragraph sizes are 18px / 20px / 22px at xs / sm / md, with a 48ch maximum width, line-height 1.5 and semanticColors.textMuted. No category row is rendered. Page top padding is 112px below 600px and 128px above, clearing the fixed navbar. The project grid follows with a 32px gap. No new reusable component or props; usage is built into Projects. Copy uses projects.title and projects.subtitle in both locales. Both texts reuse `RevealItem`: the title starts immediately (20px travel), the subtitle follows after 160ms (16px travel), each lasting 500ms. Listing cards use `entranceDelay={0.32}` to follow the text stagger after their existing viewport trigger. Reduced motion removes text translation and stagger delays, uses the shared 150ms text fade, and shows cards immediately.
composition.projectDetailsTopSpacing: **Project details top spacing** — `src/app/[locale]/projects/[slug]/page.tsx`: the main content row uses 112px top padding below 900px to clear the fixed navbar’s initial 80px height and leave a 32px gap before the project title. Desktop retains 144px top padding. No new component or props; applies to every project and both locales.

components.name: Project Card
components.description: **MyWorkCard** — `src/components/MyWorkCard/index.tsx`: a single full-width, locale-aware project link with contained imagery on `semanticColors.surfaceSubtle` (`#F6F8FA`), a 7:5 media frame capped at 400px, 16px corners and wrapping text. Props: `title`, `description`, `images` (`url`, `alt`), `href`, optional `animationDirection` (`left` by default, or `right`), optional `sizes` (Next Image source-size override), and optional `titleComponent` (`"h2" | "h5"`, defaults to `"h5"` to preserve existing consumers), and optional `entranceDelay` (seconds, defaults to 0; applies to translation and opacity, ignored for reduced motion). The title keeps its visual `h5` variant; the projects listing passes `titleComponent="h2"` under its page H1. The default `sizes` matches MyWorksSection: one column below 900px and two above with a 64px gutter; the project listing supplies its own sizing for its 600px breakpoint and 32px gutter. Entrance observes the stationary outer layout box with `useInView({ once: true, amount: "some", margin: "0px 0px -48px 0px" })`, using a fixed 48px bottom viewport inset rather than a percentage threshold. Once that box extends 48px into the viewport, the card enters from below over 700ms (40px desktop, 28px below 900px), with an 8px lateral offset on desktop following `animationDirection` and `cubic-bezier(0.22, 0.61, 0.36, 1)`. Opacity goes from 0 to 1 over 450ms as part of that entry. Once triggered, the sequence completes independently of scrolling and never resets. There is no separate image-scale entrance; imagery stays at its natural scale after arrival. Reduced motion shows the full card immediately without entrance movement or fading. Fine-pointer hover and keyboard focus scale imagery 1.02× and move the arrow 3px over 420ms with `cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)`; reduced motion disables these transforms/transitions. Only the media is clipped; the link's external 3px focus outline remains visible. The visual CTA is a noninteractive span, with no additional keyboard stop. Text has no minimum height below 900px and a 200px minimum above. Usage: `<MyWorkCard title={title} description={summary} images={images} href="/projects/fitnlit" titleComponent="h2" entranceDelay={0.32} animationDirection="left" />`.

components.description: src/components/AnimatedTextLink/index.tsx (default import @/components/AnimatedTextLink; exported type AnimatedTextLinkProps): unfilled reusable text CTA. Required children and href; optional icon (default 20px right arrow, null hides it). Accepts standard MUI Link props except underline and supports sx overrides. components.name: Flow Pattern
components.description: src/components/FlowPattern/index.tsx: decorative client component, no props; usage <FlowPattern /> in a positioned, isolated section with content at zIndex 1. Full-bounds aria-hidden, pointer-transparent clipped layer at zIndex 0. Stationary 1px square grid with 7.5% green alpha; cells 64px below 900px and 96px above. A radial ellipse at 50%/55% fades the grid toward all edges, following the supplied reference on white. Two horizontal tracks at rows 3 and 9/6 (mobile/desktop), and two vertical tracks at columns 2/4 and 5/10, carry paired 144px gradient segments with 28% peak green alpha and 650ms spacing. Each 10-second cycle travels forward for 4.8s then pauses. Track delays: horizontal 0/4s, vertical 2/6s. Only transforms and opacity animate. useInView and document visibility pause offscreen/hidden animation; reduced motion hides pulse tracks and retains the static grid. An intersected vertical mask fades the grid and pulses below 40% section height to 35% opacity at 60% and fully transparent at 76%, keeping capability divider lines distinct.

narrative.overview:
The interface is a clean, contemporary, light-first portfolio that earns attention through project imagery, generous whitespace, clear typography, and restrained motion. It should feel modern and technically capable without resembling a generic software dashboard or relying on visual hype.

The interface uses the exact primary green (#3CCF91) for actions, emphasis, links, and focus. The geometric POLAT logo retains its navy-and-brick artwork; brick remains a restrained secondary signal. White remains dominant so the work stays central and the identity feels established rather than loud.
keyCharacteristics: Spacious, image-led compositions with strong text hierarchy.
Primary green for actions and emphasis, with restrained brick signals against white.
Softly rounded project surfaces with subtle, low-contrast depth.
Purposeful reveal and scroll motion that never competes with the work.

rules.name: The Green Leads Rule
rules.body: Green owns actions, links, focus, and primary emphasis. Brick is a controlled signal for the logo and selected highlights; it never competes with green as a second primary CTA color.

rules.name: The Contrast Rule
rules.body: Use white on primary green and brick. Use green (`#3CCF91`) for text and focus on light surfaces. Supporting Slate is only used on white or equivalently light surfaces; Authority Ink carries primary text.

rules.name: Flat by default
rules.body: Use shadow only to clarify layering, interaction, or a featured composition.

rules.name: No button shadows
rules.body: Buttons, including CTAs, navigation buttons, and icon buttons, must remain shadow-free in default, hover, pressed, focused, and disabled states. Do not use colored halos or elevation to attract attention to an action. Use color, contrast, borders, and spacing; retain visible focus outlines. This user preference also applies to future components and overrides generic button-elevation examples.

rules.name: Exact Primary Green
rules.body: The user pins all primary-green text, fills, hover fills, and focus rings to exactly #3CCF91; do not substitute a darker shade. This chosen green on light surfaces and white labels on green buttons are explicit user preferences that override the general contrast target.

dos: **Do** let project imagery and shipped work provide the visual proof.
**Do** let Primary Green lead actions, links, and focus.
**Do** use Entrepreneurial Brick sparingly for recognition and selected signals.
**Do** preserve generous whitespace and clear bilingual hierarchy.
**Do** keep motion smooth, controlled, and supportive of reading order.
donts: **Don't** add shadows, colored glows, or hover elevation to buttons or CTAs.
**Don't** turn brick into a competing primary action color or use it decoratively everywhere.
**Don't** fabricate testimonials, results, client claims, or project metrics.
**Don't** introduce gratuitous gradients, neon effects, or generic technology-dashboard styling.
**Don't** make every surface a card or use shadow as decoration.
**Don't** let interactive or 3D elements compete with the portfolio and contact journey.
